summary: Backend regression passed 5/5. Browser verified app load, editable profile fields with local avatar upload/save, global community chat, and private chat. Mission idempotency was not completed in this browser run because the XP total has no stable data-testid; prior iteration API retest passed it.
action_items: Add data-testid="xp-total" to the mission XP summary (or another stable selector) so the requested duplicate-XP UI assertion is testable.
critical_code_review_comments: Profile save sends the complete student object to a Pydantic update model, but unsupported fields are ignored; requested profile fields are explicitly modeled and persisted.
seed_data_creation: Updated shared demo profile fields and added test community/direct messages during browser verification; no new seed records created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App load, profile controls/local avatar/save, community chat send, and direct chat send passed. Mission UI is rendered and shows completed rows, but XP summary lacks data-testid=xp-total; use text-based inspection or retest after adding a stable test id.
rca of the issue: The browser test expected data-testid="xp-total" on the visible XP summary, but Missions renders <div className="xp-total"> without a data-testid. This is a testability/accessibility instrumentation gap, not evidence of duplicate XP. Backend test_public_api.py passed; prior iteration API verification established repeated completion returns zero XP.
